title: Default Green Blue Theme FX
description: The standard Minecraft textures, but with a green and blue theme.
body:
💚 Default Green Blue Theme – Clean & Modern Interface 💙

Give your Minecraft a fresh and calming look with the Default Green Blue Theme texture pack. This pack replaces the default GUI with a modern design featuring smooth blue and green tones — perfect for players who prefer a clean and eye-friendly interface.

🌿 Features:

✔️ Minimalist GUI with a blue-green color palette
✔️ Easy on the eyes for long play sessions
✔️ Redesigned menus, inventory, and HUD
✔️ Lightweight & performance-friendly
✔️ Compatible with most mods and clients

 🧩 Whether you're playing PvP, Survival, or Creative — Default Green Blue Theme adds a stylish touch without distracting from gameplay.
